title: Statistical inference for extremal directions in high-dimensional spaces
summary: In multivariate extreme value statistics, the first step in understanding the dependence structure of extremes is identifying the directions in which they occur. The novelty of this paper is the analysis of high-dimensional extreme value models in which both the model dimension and the number of bias directions go to infinity as the number of observations tends to infinity; we estimate the number of extremal directions.
